# Archived Qwen3 output-fidelity screen v1

The [contract](contract.json) freezes a new screen before numerical comparison:
two512-position cases, all151936 vocabulary entries, one archived chunk128
native capture and its independent FP64-arithmetic/Half-storage CPU reference.
It binds raw parents, complete logit-frame extents/hashes, exact token sequences,
historical model/binary/numerical sources and the screen's runtime/source closure.
The comparison method and inclusive0.05 maximum absolute normalized-log-probability
error are fixed, with exact lowest-ID greedy agreement and nonfinite rejection.

This is an archival output screen. The earlier canonical FP32 stage gate remains
rejected. A pass can authorize the eight untouched numerical-validation inputs;
it cannot qualify the current loader, diagnostic1025 path, app or full model
window. A failure rejects this candidate under this contract and leaves those
validation inputs unopened. There is no automatic dtype switch or gate widening.

The [reader](../../../tools/reference/qwen3_output_screen.py) streams saved FP32
rows, widens them exactly to FP64 and records every position before aggregate
classification. All raw parent/frame/array identities and endpoint checks must
pass for a completed result, including a completed numerical rejection.

See the [focused delivery queue](../../../docs/qwen3-mac-delivery-plan.md).
